svg.title: KServe Kernel Cache architecture
svg.desc: Kubernetes API resources coordinate capture, OCI artifact preparation, and reuse. An MCV sidecar in the producer Pod pushes an OCI image and reports results to KernelCacheCapture. Controllers create KernelCache. A prefetch Job makes the image available on each matching node. The DaemonSet agent updates KernelCacheNode status, and admission mounts compatible caches into new serving Pods.

g.text: Kubernetes resources, runtime Pods, and OCI artifacts
Mount compatible caches into new Pods
NODE-LOCAL OCI CACHE · artifact available for compatible Pods
Pull OCI artifact via image volume
Each selected GPU node has an Agent Pod and a corresponding KernelCacheNode resource.
Custom resources and the DaemonSet are shown outside the node; workload and agent Pods run inside it.
